resources.string: Pick an item on the left, or add a new one.
Its photos and text will be removed from Garasi on this PC and, after the next sync, on your phone.
Add photos from your PC, or take them with the phone app — they sync here automatically.
Click a photo to reorder, crop, tag or delete it.
Opens Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini in your browser with the prompt (it\'s also on your clipboard — paste it if the box is empty). Copy the AI\'s whole answer, then click \"Paste AI answer\".
Prompt copied and %1$s opened. Paste it if the box is empty.
Prompt copied to the clipboard. Paste it into your AI chat.
Open the seller page, then use these buttons one by one — each copies the next thing to paste.
Scan with the Garasi phone app
1. Connect your phone to the same Wi-Fi as this PC.\n2. In the phone app: Settings → Set up PC sync → Scan QR code.\n3. Done. The phone syncs whenever you open it (or tap the sync button).
No camera? Choose \"Enter address & code\" on the phone and type:
Ready — waiting for your phone on port %1$d.
Couldn\'t start sync: %1$s. Is another copy of Garasi already open?
First time: if Windows asks about network access, allow Garasi on private networks so your phone can reach it.
A new code disconnects phones paired with the old one — scan the QR code again on your phone.
Everything is stored on this PC in %1$s (data.json + photos). Copy that folder to back it up.
Garasi for Windows runs entirely on your PC. No accounts, no paid APIs, no scraping. Phone sync stays on your own Wi-Fi.
